freePracticeDay.title: Free practice
freePracticeDay.coding: Pick 4–6 problems across patterns — heap, intervals, DP, or any pattern that still feels shaky. Mix easy + medium. Narrate, no AI.
freePracticeDay.systemDesign: Pick a system from the Reference Library you haven't rehearsed — design it out loud, recorded.
freePracticeDay.rule: 15-day plan is done. Daily structure stays. Keep showing up.
